core_meaning.primary_meaning: Wadud (الودود) is a divine name meaning “the Loving” or “the Affectionate”. It occurs in Qur'an 11:90 and 85:14. The root و د د carries the sense of love, and the name is used for boys; the feminine form Waduda is also attested as a given name.

persian.name: ودود

arabic.name: وَدُود
